bio.text: Johnny Garrett, a Republican from Goodlettsville, has represented District 45 (part of Sumner County) in the Tennessee House of Representatives since November 2018, and is the Republican candidate for U.S. House in Tennessee's 6th District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The Tennessee General Assembly's member page lists him as an attorney and as House Majority Whip.
He holds a business degree from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville and a law degree from the Nashville School of Law.
